description: This Java class serves as a REST controller for managing user-related operations in a book project application. It provides endpoints for retrieving user details, checking email existence, registration, deletion, and updating email and password. The class interacts with services like UserService and EmailService, and includes exception handling and authorization logic.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: REST controller for user management endpoints, handling registration, deletion, retrieval, and updates for user data.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieve user details by user ID.

methods.name: emailExists
methods.description: Check if an email exists in the system.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Register a new user and send a confirmation email.

methods.name: deleteCurrentUser
methods.description: Delete the currently authenticated user after password verification.

methods.name: updateEmail
methods.description: Update the email address of the current user after password verification.

methods.name: updatePassword
methods.description: Update the password of the current user after verifying current password, then send confirmation email.
